title: Star Catcher
tagline: Fly Kitty's rocket, catch falling stars, and watch your star pictures come alive!
howToPlay: Drag a finger (or use the arrow keys) to fly Kitty's rocket into the falling stars, and each planet sends its own kind, from bouncy candies to stars in bubbles. Every finished star picture wakes up as a bear, fish, bird, bunny, butterfly or cat that plays, follows the rocket and does a trick when tapped (hold 🏠 to leave a trip).
learning: Hand-eye coordination, tracking moving things, and spotting shapes in the stars
